1250: 		 * The behavior of methods which are not listed above will not be
1251: 		 * affected by calling this method.
1252: 		 * <p>
1253: 		 * Calling this method multiple times will result in an
1254: 		 * {@link IllegalStateException} to be thrown.
1255: 		 * 
1256: 		 * @param allowOverwrite	If {@code true} then existing files will be
1257: 		 * 							overwritten if specified as a destination.
1258: 		 * 							If {@code false}, then the existing files
1259: 		 * 							will not be altered. For specific behavior,
1260: 		 * 							please refer to the specific output methods
1261: 		 * 							listed above.
1262: 		 * @return					Reference to this object.
1263: 		 * @since 	0.3.7
1264: 		 */
1265: 		public Builder<T> allowOverwrite(boolean allowOverwrite) {
1266: 			updateStatus(Properties.ALLOW_OVERWRITE, Status.ALREADY_SET);
1267: 			this.allowOverwrite = allowOverwrite;
1268: 			
1269: 			return this;
1270: 		}
1271: 		
1272: 		/**
1273: 		 * Sets the image type of the thumbnail.
1274: 		 * <p>
1275: 		 * Calling this method to set this parameter is optional.
1276: 		 * <p>
1277: 		 * Calling this method multiple times will result in an
1278: 		 * {@link IllegalStateException} to be thrown.
1279: 		 * 
1280: 		 * @param type			The image type of the thumbnail.
1281: 		 * @return				Reference to this object.
1282: 		 */
1283: 		public Builder<T> imageType(int type) {
1284: 			updateStatus(Properties.IMAGE_TYPE, Status.ALREADY_SET);
1285: 			imageType = type;
1286: 			return this;
1287: 		}
1288: 
1289: 		/**
1290: 		 * Sets the resizing scaling mode to use when creating the thumbnail.
1291: 		 * <p>
1292: 		 * Calling this method to set this parameter is optional.
1293: 		 * <p>
1294: 		 * Calling this method multiple times will result in an
1295: 		 * {@link IllegalStateException} to be thrown.
1296: 		 * 
1297: 		 * @param config		The scaling mode to use.
1298: 		 * @return				Reference to this object.
1299: 		 */
1300: 		public Builder<T> scalingMode(ScalingMode config) {
1301: 			checkForNull(config, "Scaling mode is null.");
1302: 			updateStatus(Properties.SCALING_MODE, Status.ALREADY_SET);
1303: 			updateStatus(Properties.RESIZER, Status.CANNOT_SET);
1304: 			updateStatus(Properties.RESIZER_FACTORY, Status.CANNOT_SET);
1305: 			scalingMode = config;
1306: 			return this;
1307: 		}
1308: 		
1309: 		/**
1310: 		 * Sets the resizing operation to use when creating the thumbnail.
1311: 		 * <p>
1312: 		 * Calling this method to set this parameter is optional.
1313: 		 * <p>
1314: 		 * Calling this method multiple times will result in an
1315: 		 * {@link IllegalStateException} to be thrown.
1316: 		 * <p>
1317: 		 * This method cannot be called in conjunction with the
1318: 		 * {@link #resizerFactory(ResizerFactory)} method.
1319: 		 * 
1320: 		 * @param resizer		The scaling operation to use.
1321: 		 * @return				Reference to this object.
1322: 		 */
1323: 		public Builder<T> resizer(Resizer resizer) {
1324: 			checkForNull(resizer, "Resizer is null.");
1325: 			updateStatus(Properties.RESIZER, Status.ALREADY_SET);
1326: 			updateStatus(Properties.RESIZER_FACTORY, Status.CANNOT_SET);
1327: 			updateStatus(Properties.SCALING_MODE, Status.CANNOT_SET);
1328: 			this.resizerFactory = new FixedResizerFactory(resizer);
1329: 			return this;
1330: 		}
1331: 		
1332: 		/**
1333: 		 * Sets the {@link ResizerFactory} object to use to decide what kind of
1334: 		 * resizing operation is to be used when creating the thumbnail.
1335: 		 * <p>
1336: 		 * Calling this method to set this parameter is optional.
1337: 		 * <p>
1338: 		 * Calling this method multiple times will result in an
1339: 		 * {@link IllegalStateException} to be thrown.
1340: 		 * <p>
1341: 		 * This method cannot be called in conjunction with the
1342: 		 * {@link #resizer(Resizer)} method.
1343: 		 * 
1344: 		 * @param resizerFactory		The scaling operation to use.
1345: 		 * @return						Reference to this object.
1346: 		 * @since	0.4.0
1347: 		 */
1348: 		public Builder<T> resizerFactory(ResizerFactory resizerFactory) {
1349: 			checkForNull(resizerFactory, "ResizerFactory is null.");
1350: 			updateStatus(Properties.RESIZER_FACTORY, Status.ALREADY_SET);
1351: 			updateStatus(Properties.RESIZER, Status.CANNOT_SET);
1352: 			
1353: 			// disable the methods which set parameters for the Resizer
1354: 			updateStatus(Properties.SCALING_MODE, Status.CANNOT_SET);
1355: 			updateStatus(Properties.ALPHA_INTERPOLATION, Status.CANNOT_SET);
1356: 			updateStatus(Properties.DITHERING, Status.CANNOT_SET);
1357: 			updateStatus(Properties.ANTIALIASING, Status.CANNOT_SET);
1358: 			updateStatus(Properties.RENDERING, Status.CANNOT_SET);
1359: 			
1360: 			this.resizerFactory = resizerFactory;
1361: 			return this;
1362: 		}
1363: 		
1364: 		/**
1365: 		 * Sets the alpha interpolation mode when performing the resizing
1366: 		 * operation to generate the thumbnail.
1367: 		 * <p>
1368: 		 * Calling this method to set this parameter is optional.
1369: 		 * <p>
1370: 		 * Calling this method multiple times will result in an
1371: 		 * {@link IllegalStateException} to be thrown.
1372: 		 * <p>
1373: 		 * This method cannot be called in conjunction with the
1374: 		 * {@link #resizerFactory(ResizerFactory)} method.
1375: 		 * 
1376: 		 * @param config		The alpha interpolation mode.
1377: 		 * @return				Reference to this object.
1378: 		 */
1379: 		public Builder<T> alphaInterpolation(AlphaInterpolation config) {
1380: 			checkForNull(config, "Alpha interpolation is null.");
1381: 			updateStatus(Properties.RESIZER_FACTORY, Status.CANNOT_SET);
1382: 			updateStatus(Properties.ALPHA_INTERPOLATION, Status.ALREADY_SET);
1383: 			alphaInterpolation = config;
1384: 			return this;
1385: 		}
1386: 
1387: 		/**
1388: 		 * Sets the dithering mode when performing the resizing
1389: 		 * operation to generate the thumbnail.
1390: 		 * <p>
1391: 		 * Calling this method to set this parameter is optional.
1392: 		 * <p>
1393: 		 * Calling this method multiple times will result in an
1394: 		 * {@link IllegalStateException} to be thrown.
1395: 		 * <p>
1396: 		 * This method cannot be called in conjunction with the
1397: 		 * {@link #resizerFactory(ResizerFactory)} method.
1398: 		 * 
1399: 		 * @param config		The dithering mode.
1400: 		 * @return				Reference to this object.
1401: 		 */
1402: 		public Builder<T> dithering(Dithering config) {
1403: 			checkForNull(config, "Dithering is null.");
1404: 			updateStatus(Properties.RESIZER_FACTORY, Status.CANNOT_SET);
1405: 			updateStatus(Properties.DITHERING, Status.ALREADY_SET);
